description: This file defines the HolidayService class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It manages holiday-related operations such as searching, caching, and determining holiday types, interacting with the HolidayDao data access object and utilizing caching and configuration traits.

classes.name: HolidayService
classes.description: Service class responsible for holiday management, including searching, caching, and determining holiday types within the OrangeHRM employee management system.

methods.name: getHolidayDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the HolidayDao instance used for database operations related to holidays.

methods.name: saveHoliday
methods.description: Saves a Holiday entity and clears related cache.

methods.name: getHolidaysCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on date range for holiday caching.

methods.name: searchHolidays
methods.description: Searches for holidays within a specified filter, supports pagination.

methods.name: searchHolidaysCount
methods.description: Returns the count of holidays matching the search filter.

methods.name: searchHolidaysAlongWithCache
methods.description: Retrieves holidays from cache or calculates if not cached, for a given date range.

methods.name: getCalculatedHolidays
methods.description: Calculates the list of holidays (including recurring ones) within a date range.

methods.name: isHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a full-day holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if a given day is a half-day holiday.

methods.name: isHalfDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks if a given day is marked as a half-day holiday.

methods.name: deleteHolidays
methods.description: Deletes holidays by their IDs and clears cache.
